tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Physicochemical properties of KLK and mKLK.
footnotes: aPhysicochemical parameter (hydrophobicity and hydrophobic moment) were calculated by HeliQuest, a web server to screen sequences with specific alphahelical properties [https://heliquest.ipmc.cnrs.fr/cgi-bin/ComputParams.py].
bAMP probability was predicted by a web-based prediction tool dPABBs (http://ab-openlab.csir.res.in/abp/antibiofilm/) using support vector machine (SVM) algorithm.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: The MIC, MBC, MBEC and SI values of the KLK and mKLK against S. aureus isolates.
footnotes: MIC, minimum inhibitory concentration; MBC, minimum bactericidal concentration; MBEC, minimum biofilm eradication concentration; SI, selectivity index calculated as the ratio between HC50 and MIC.
